label: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 2
title: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 2
summary:
Q1 ENRICHED SINGLE-SHOT (LOCATE = one GET /search?k=8 code tier) — CONFIRMED the fix on the real shipped path. Clean Q1-only A/B (enriched vs thin embed, IDENTICAL fetch+metric, two isolated workspaces on one daemon):
  ENRICHED: mean body-recall 0.705, hits 10/13, ~1153 tok, ~442 tok/correct
  THIN    : mean body-recall 0.385, hits  6/13, ~1158 tok, ~658 tok/correct
  LIFT: 0.385 -> 0.705 (+0.321). Thin reproduces the shipped-thin 0.385 reference EXACTLY; enriched (0.705) exceeds the prior enriched-DIAGNOSTIC 0.647. Body-fold flips q02/q04/q07/q08/q10/q13 miss->hit; q11 regressed (thin 1.0 -> enr 0.0; body fold pulled a distractor). CAVEAT: an earlier run that INTERLEAVED Q1 and Q2 per-query reported a contaminated 0.462 (Q2's agentic calls mutated recall-journal/telemetry state perturbing later Q1 /search rankings); the clean Q1-only A/B (0.705) is the trustworthy number.
